column1: # Catalog of vendored City of New York source files — one row per fetchable
# artifact. Tab-separated. The fetch scripts read this, so adding a release or
# dataset is a one-line edit here, not a code change.
#   type        pluto | dob   — which fetch workflow handles the row
#   slug        stable id (also the BigQuery table / build/schemas basename)
#   url         where the file is fetched from
#   filename    downloaded artifact name (zip for pluto, csv for dob)
#   dataset_id  NYC Open Data 4x4 id, or the DCP PLUTO release code
# PLUTO releases (DCP BYTES of the BIG APPLE) — zip of CSV, fetched by
# MapPLUTO lot geometry (DCP) — zip of a shapefile, converted to GeoJSONL and
# DOB open datasets (data.cityofnewyork.us) — single CSV, fetched + snapshotted
# to GCS by build/vendor_dataset.sh  (make vendor.permits / vendor.stalled / vendor.building).
